item.title: New bill aims to aid first-time buyers and boost affordability
item.description: Rep. Tom Barrett has introduced a legislative package to improve housing affordability, including bills to prevent large corporations from buying up houses, create tax-free homebuyer savings accounts, give first-time buyers a 15-day window to purchase foreclosed homes, and study the feasibility of mortgage loan portability.
